regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, keywords, and SI availability statement
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate triple-cyclization claim. The article mentions online SI, but workspace association is unestablished and no SI fact was imported.

regions.region: page 1 introduction and Scheme 1a
regions.finding: The Pd(OAc)2/TFP/Na2CO3/H2O/CH3CN terminal-alkyne annulation is explicitly the authors' previous work (reference 10) and is classified as a literature example, not a current-paper experiment.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1b
regions.finding: The ester-substituted carbonate plus diol/disulfonamide arrow is the generic concept of this work; experiment-specific rows are represented separately.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right initial 4a/5a experiment
regions.finding: The 4a/5a/Pd(PPh3)4/Et3N/THF 70 °C/7 h, 33% NMR observation is Table 1 entry 1 on page 2 and is merged rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Scheme 1 contains generic R/Z/FG structures rather than unique compounds.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 header, entries 1–14, and footnotes
regions.finding: Fourteen independent optimization conditions were retained with CuI loading, base, solvent, time, crude-1H-NMR yield or table dash, and Pd(OAc)2/TFP or Pd(OAc)2/PPh3 replacement footnotes.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 2 reaction header and ten product drawings
regions.finding: Ten ordinary substrate-scope experiments plus a separate 4 mmol 6aa scale-up were retained. The 6da pre/post-recrystallization yields and E/Z ratios remain successive outcomes of one run; 6ja uses its complete alternate Pd(OAc)2/TFP/Na2CO3/H2O/CH3CN footnote conditions.

regions.region: page 2 lower discussion of optimization and scope
regions.finding: Narrative statements were reconciled with row records. The 6aa ordinary row is linked to the page-5 detailed procedure; the 4 mmol/19 h scale-up remains independent.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right failure and disulfonamide discussion
regions.finding: The two chain-extended diol failures are shown on page 3 and remain separate. The disulfonamide products require silica chromatography followed by DCM/hexane recrystallization; Table 3 rows remain distinct.

unresolved: Table 1 dashes are source markers and are not assigned zero or not-detected semantics.
Most Table 2 rows omit exact masses, workup, purification, and product mass.

regions.region: page 3 upper Scheme 2 equations a and b
regions.finding: Two distinct 4a trials with hex-3-yne-1,6-diol (6 h) or hex-3-yne-2,5-diol (15 h) were inspected. Both expected products are explicitly labeled not formed, and the prose calls the reactions complicated.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Table 3 header, six product drawings, and footnotes
regions.finding: Six independent disulfonamide-scope experiments were retained with substrate/sulfamide identity, 0.3 mmol scale, catalyst/additive/base/solvent, 70 °C, row time, and isolated yield.

regions.region: page 3 right Scheme 3 and mechanism prose
regions.finding: The intermolecular and intramolecular cycles with IN-1 through IN-9 are proposed mechanisms, not isolated preparations. The drawing/prose spans pages 3–4 and is represented once.

regions.region: page 3 discussion of X-ray assignment for 6bb
regions.finding: The 6bb crystal statement points to Figure 1/page 4 and footnote 11/page 6; it characterizes the Table 3 product and does not create another experiment.

unresolved: The failed-mixture compositions and analytical detection limits are not reported.
CCDC 1881002 is not treated as associated SI.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left mechanism continuation
regions.finding: Completes the proposed Scheme 3 comparison and CuI interpretation; no new experimental run or intermediate yield is introduced.

regions.region: page 4 upper-right Scheme 4 equations a–e
regions.finding: Five distinct controls were retained: two 4a/4b plus 5d two-product runs; a no-CuI complicated run with 46% 4a recovery; a 1 h run yielding 9ad/8ad; and a 7ad stability run with 9ad not observed and 100% 7ad recovery.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left Figure 1 ORTEP of 6bb·CHCl3
regions.finding: X-ray characterization supports the existing Table 3 6bb assignment; it is not a second preparation or machine-structure verification.

regions.region: page 4 lower-right Scheme 5 synthetic applications
regions.finding: Two distinct product transformations were retained: aerobic Fe(NO3)3·9H2O/TEMPO/NaCl oxidation to 10aa (76%) and NBS cyclization from 0 °C to room temperature over 2 h to 11aa (65%). The scheme/prose 6aa versus 6ab substrate-label conflict is preserved.

unresolved: Scheme 5 drawing labels the oxidation substrate 6aa while the prose says 6ab.
Several control/application yields lack an explicit measurement basis and operational workup.
The NBS addition time and any separate 0 °C hold are not reported.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left summary and General Experimental Methods
regions.finding: Summary adds no new experiment. General methods establish nitrogen-dried solvents and oil-bath temperature convention but are not independent reaction records.

regions.region: page 5 left-column Typical Procedure for 6aa
regions.finding: The existing Table 2 ordinary 6aa row was enriched with exact CuI/Pd(PPh3)4/5a/4a/THF/Et3N charges, sequential nitrogen charging, 70 °C/5 h, TLC, silica-pad/EtOAc workup, chromatography, 0.1673 g/68%, and 197.6–200.1 °C melting point.

regions.region: page 5 lower-left acknowledgments
regions.finding: Weifeng Zheng is thanked for reproducing 6bb, (E)-6ga, and 6ia. No independent conditions, quantities, yields, or run identifiers are given, so these are provenance notes on existing records, not duplicate experiments.

regions.region: page 5 right-column references 1–4
regions.finding: Bibliography/prior-literature citations only; external papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: The reproduction acknowledgment does not identify separable runs.
The detailed procedure supplies only the ordinary 6aa row, not all scope rows.

regions.region: page 6 references 4–10 and 12–14
regions.finding: Bibliography and prior-work citations only; they were not converted into current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 6 footnote 11 crystal data for 6bb·CHCl3 and CCDC 1881002
regions.finding: Crystal data characterize the existing Table 3 6bb product and support the source assignment. The deposition is not a new reaction, is not treated as an associated SI file, and does not verify a machine structure encoding.

unresolved: CCDC 1881002 is a crystallographic deposition rather than an explicitly associated workspace SI file.
Crystallography does not establish semantic accuracy or verify machine SMILES.
No new reaction operation or yield occurs on page 6.
